about: Real questions the owner asks Ava. Run with scripts/ava-eval.mjs against the live machine (needs a key; not part of npm test). 'expect' is what a good answer does — read the answers and judge.

questions.q: What needs me today?
questions.expect: Calls list_clients (needs_you); names the clients and the to-do types, most urgent first.

questions.q: Is anything urgent right now?
questions.expect: Urgent to-dos and open alerts, or says nothing is urgent.

questions.q: Who is waiting for my yes?
questions.expect: New applications and call times waiting for a yes (calendar).

questions.q: How is Summit Roofing doing?
questions.expect: get_client: day, emails sent, replies, interested, calls booked; next step.

questions.q: How many replies did Harbor Dental get and what kind?
questions.expect: Reply count and the reply types from get_client.

questions.q: Which trials are warming up and when will they start sending?
questions.expect: list_clients warming_up with warm-up day / ready-by dates.

questions.q: How many calls have we booked across all clients this month?
questions.expect: get_numbers all_clients: booked / qualified totals.

questions.q: How is my own outreach going?
questions.expect: get_numbers my_outreach: sent, opens, replies, bounces.

questions.q: How much money came in this month?
questions.expect: Owner: get_numbers money — received this month and unpaid. Team member: says it is only for the owner.

questions.q: Who is on the waiting list?
questions.expect: The waiting list names, or that it is empty; 3 trials at once.

questions.q: What calls do I have tomorrow?
questions.expect: get_calendar for tomorrow, Sri Lanka time with Eastern.

questions.q: When is the next launch call?
questions.expect: The next launch-call meeting with the company and time.

questions.q: Who on the team is online and what are they working on?
questions.expect: search_hub team: first names, online, status line.

questions.q: How do I give a client access to their own page?
questions.expect: Open the client → email system → Setup → Who can see this → Give access; owner only; offers to open it.

questions.q: How does warm-up work and how long does it take?
questions.expect: About 14 days, 90% two days in a row, helpers if the circle is short.

questions.q: How do I add a warm-up helper?
questions.expect: Settings › Warm-up → Add a helper → kind → app password → Test and add.

questions.q: What happens on day 30 of a trial?
questions.expect: Decision page, one recommended plan, 24-hour bonus; extension if no qualified call.

questions.q: What are our plan prices?
questions.expect: Starter $2,497 / 10 calls, Growth $3,997 / 20, Scale $8,497 / 50; $150 per extra call; pay per show $250.

questions.q: What counts as a qualified call?
questions.expect: Held, right title, approved company, booked from our outreach.

questions.q: How do I set up Google Meet links?
questions.expect: Settings › Google Meet steps; Connect Google; Test it.

questions.q: How do I get a free Cloudflare key for you?
questions.expect: dash.cloudflare.com, Account ID, API token with the Workers AI template, paste both in Settings › Keys.

questions.q: Why is Opened blank for my clients?
questions.expect: No open tracker on client emails on purpose (deliverability).

questions.q: What does the client see on their page?
questions.expect: Shared tabs only; never money, costs, fit score, internal to-dos.

questions.q: How do I approve a new team member?
questions.expect: Activity → Approve; read-only; Team → Choose clients.

questions.q: What should I do if bounces go up?
questions.expect: 1.5% halves speed, over 2% stops; check the list/email checkers, Deliverability tab.

questions.q: Open the calendar
questions.expect: A navigate action to the calendar.

questions.q: Take me to the keys settings
questions.expect: Navigate to settings / keys.

questions.q: I wish the trials list showed the warm-up day. Can you change that?
questions.expect: Says she can't edit the code; proposes add_change_request.

questions.q: Write a short friendly email to Summit Roofing telling them their launch call is confirmed for Thursday.
questions.expect: A draft action with a short, warm email; no invented numbers.

questions.q: Help me reply to a client who asks why they have no calls yet after 10 days.
questions.expect: A calm, honest draft explaining warm-up/ramp and what happens next.

questions.q: Rewrite this to sound more professional: hey, your invoice is due, pls pay asap
questions.expect: A polite, professional rewrite.

questions.q: What is the CAN-SPAM Act in two sentences?
questions.expect: A correct short explanation.

questions.q: What time is it in New York when it's 9 pm in Colombo?
questions.expect: Correct conversion (Colombo is UTC+5:30; New York EDT UTC−4 / EST UTC−5).

questions.q: Give me three tips to improve cold email reply rates.
questions.expect: Three useful, concrete tips.

questions.q: What is 15% of 3,997?
Explain SPF, DKIM and DMARC simply.
questions.expect: A clear plain-words explanation.

questions.q: What are the latest Gmail and Yahoo rules for bulk senders?
questions.expect: Uses web_search (with a Tavily/Exa key) and names sources; otherwise says it may be out of date.

questions.q: What's in the news about AI today?
questions.expect: web_search with sources, or says it can't look it up without a search key.

questions.q: What's the weather in Colombo right now?
questions.expect: web_search; never invents a live number without it.

questions.q: What is the current USD to LKR exchange rate?
questions.expect: web_search with a source and date, or a clear 'may be out of date'.

questions.q: How many trials are running?
questions.expect: One or two spoken sentences, no lists or symbols.

questions.q: What should I do first today?
questions.expect: Short spoken answer naming the most urgent thing.
